original_question: Let ℓ(X) denote the composition length of a finite group X. Let A be a finite nilpotent group acting by automorphisms on a finite soluble group G. Let c(G, A) be the number of trivial A-modules in a given A-composition series of G. (Note that c(G, A) = ℓ(CG(A)) if(|A|, |G|) = 1.) Conjecture: there are absolute constants C1 and C2 such that the Fitting height of G is at most C1 ℓ(A) + C2 c(G, A). İ. Güloǧlu
target_in_paper: Problem 21.56 in the section "New Problems (21st issue, 2026)": the conjecture asking whether there exist absolute constants C1 and C2 such that h(G) ≤ C1ℓ(A) + C2c(G,A) whenever a finite nilpotent group A acts by automorphisms on a finite soluble group G. ([alglog.org](https://alglog.org/21tkt.pdf?utm_source=openai))
correct_elements: Your draft is already extremely close to the official formulation: it has the correct hypotheses (A finite nilpotent, G finite soluble, action by automorphisms), the correct invariants ℓ(A) and c(G,A), the coprime note identifying c(G,A) with ℓ(C_G(A)), and the correct conjectural linear upper bound for the Fitting height. ([alglog.org](https://alglog.org/21tkt.pdf?utm_source=openai))
missing_details: Make the quantifiers explicit: the same absolute constants C1 and C2 are required to work for every finite nilpotent group A and every finite soluble group G under such an action.
State explicitly that h(G) denotes the Fitting height of G.
Clarify that an "A-composition series" means an A-invariant composition series of G, and that c(G,A) counts the factors on which A acts trivially.

Use the fixed-point notation C_G(A) in the coprime note, and make clear that the condition (|A|,|G|)=1 is only a special-case observation about c(G,A), not an extra hypothesis of the conjecture. ([alglog.org](https://alglog.org/21tkt.pdf?utm_source=openai))
refined_question: Does there exist a pair of absolute constants C1 and C2 such that, for every finite nilpotent group A acting by automorphisms on every finite soluble group G, the Fitting height h(G) satisfies h(G) ≤ C1ℓ(A) + C2c(G,A), where ℓ(X) denotes the composition length of a finite group X and c(G,A) is the number of trivial A-modules occurring among the factors of a chosen A-invariant composition series of G? In the coprime case (|A|,|G|)=1, this parameter is equal to ℓ(C_G(A)). ([alglog.org](https://alglog.org/21tkt.pdf?utm_source=openai))
